Class RandomBag<T>

java.lang.Object
be.imgn.gaia.core.random.RandomBag<T>
Type Parameters:
T - the type of the elements
public final class RandomBag<T> extends Object
A bag to draw elements from at random, without putting them back: a deck of cards, or a list of options that must each come up once before any comes up again. 
var deck = RandomBag.of(cards);
var hand = deck.draw(5, random);      // five different cards
deck.size();                          // 47
deck.refill();                        // the hand is back in the deck

var track = RandomBag.of(playlist).refilling();
track.next(random);                   // every track once, in a random order, then all of them again

An element that is in the bag several times may be drawn as many times. A bag remembers the elements that were drawn, so that refill() puts them back at no cost.

Each draw calls nextInt(size) once, even when one element is left. Which element a number draws depends on the previous draws.

Bags are mutable, and aren't safe to use from several threads at once.

Since:
0.2.0
